title: Aligned word vectors
blurb: Months, weekdays, seasons, hours and compass points: words for things that go round. The same {len(WORDS)} concepts as English and as Russian fastText vectors (300 dimensions each, aligned into one space).

notes.cka: Caveat: these vectors were trained to be aligned across languages (that is what “aligned” means here), so a high score is partly by construction. The interesting bits are where they still disagree.
notes.neighbors: Weekdays are the most loyal. Numbers like five and six are the most fickle, probably because Russian numerals inflect for case and also show up in dates, prices and ages.

about.name: Aligned word vectors
about.quote: We are publishing aligned word vectors for 44 languages based on the pre-trained vectors computed on Wikipedia using fastText. The alignments are performed with the RCSLS method described in Joulin et al (2018).
about.label: fasttext.cc

here: Here: 46 words for things that go round (months, weekdays, seasons, times of day, directions, one to twelve), in English (A) and Russian (B).
